reason: I've already paid a consultant for a 'strategy' that ended up as a slide deck and zero pipeline, so I'm not putting EUR 3,500 down on something called revenue architecture because of two anonymous case studies. Six weeks of setup with no guaranteed meetings sounds exactly like last time.
objection: No meetings are guaranteed, and the 'past clients' are a logistics company and some unnamed niche. Neither is a SaaS or IT services firm selling into DACH. I can't tell whether I'd be paying for a working pipeline or a nice ICP document and a rewritten LinkedIn profile.
would_change_my_mind: A named SaaS or IT services reference in DACH that I can actually call, plus part of the sprint fee tied to the first qualified meetings (for example half refunded if no meetings come in by day 60).
